in_marathi.name: Anushree
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Anu (meaning new) + Shree (meaning goddess of wealth and prosperity)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anushree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anushree is a beautiful Sanskrit name for girls. It is a combination of two words: Anu and Shree. Anu means new or fresh, and Shree is the goddess of wealth and prosperity. Anushree represents the fresh start of a new life filled with prosperity and abundance.
